name: Agatha Christie: Murder on the Orient Express

locations.note: The game opens with a 1924 flashback to one of Poirot’s earlier cases in New Paltz.
The player begins at Istanbul’s Sirkeci Terminal before boarding the Orient Express.
The train is stopped by an avalanche on the Yugoslav section of the route; the player investigates the snowbound train and its surroundings.

routes.name: Antoinette Marceau
routes.note: From Istanbul's Sirkeci Terminal westward on the Orient Express until an avalanche traps the train in the Yugoslav snow with a murderer aboard.
